_comment: Public sources of the planetary data FFM embeds and of the truth its planetary E2E scores against. scripts/fetch-planetary-sources.mjs downloads each into <dir>/<directory>/ and refuses a file whose SHA-256 differs. Nothing downloaded is executed. License and redistribution notes are as the publishers state them; the bytes committed to the repository are only the derived, reduced products listed under embedded in lib/data/planetary/SOURCES.json and the truth fixtures in tests/fixtures/planetary/. fixtures lists the committed derived bytes with their SHA-256; scripts/fetch-planetary-sources.mjs verifies them too.

grgm660prim.title: GRGM660PRIM, GSFC lunar gravity field, degree and order 660, fully normalized, reference radius 1738.0 km, principal-axes frame of planetary ephemeris DE421
grgm660prim.citation: Lemoine et al. 2013, J. Geophys. Res. Planets 118, doi:10.1002/jgre.20118; PDS dataset GRAIL-L-LGRS-5-RDR-V1.0
grgm660prim.license: NASA Planetary Data System open data; no use restriction stated; citation requested
grgm660prim.redistribution: redistributable; the repository commits the float32 reduction to degree 150 of the field's 660 (the degree past which the day-2 prediction error of the planetary E2E's two LRO windows stops falling: 46, 28, 38, 31 m at degrees 120, 150, 200, 260, tests/planetary-degree-sweep.mjs; the size budget of the default artifact; the full field is a typed data input to come)

mro120f.title: MRO120F, JPL Mars gravity field, degree and order 120, fully normalized, reference radius 3396.0 km, with its own Mars-fixed frame (the label's Euler-angle model)
mro120f.citation: Konopliv et al. 2020, Geophys. Res. Lett. 47, e2020GL090568, doi:10.1029/2020GL090568; PDS dataset MRO-M-RSS-5-SDP-V1.0
mro120f.license: NASA Planetary Data System open data; no use restriction stated; citation requested
mro120f.redistribution: redistributable; the repository commits only the float32 reduction

moon-pa-de440.title: DE440 lunar principal-axis libration angles (binary PCK)
moon-pa-de440.citation: Park et al. 2021, Astron. J. 161:105, doi:10.3847/1538-3881/abd414; NAIF generic kernels
moon-pa-de440.license: NAIF/JPL public data; no use restriction stated
moon-pa-de440.redistribution: redistributable; the repository commits the Chebyshev records of the 2022-2037 window unchanged (the size budget of the default artifact; a binary PCK typed input to come covers any span)

de440s.title: JPL DE440 planetary ephemeris, 1849-2150 (the short file), the kernel input of every planetary request
de440s.license: NAIF/JPL public data; no use restriction stated
de440s.redistribution: redistributable; not committed here (32.7 MB), fetched and verified

pck00011.title: NAIF planetary constants kernel (IAU WGCCRE 2015 rotation models and radii), the oracle for the Mars pole and spin check

lro-reconstructed.title: LRO reconstructed trajectory (NAIF target -85 relative to the Moon, J2000), 2026-03-15 to 2026-06-15, big-endian DAF
lro-reconstructed.redistribution: redistributable; not committed, the E2E commits sampled states

mro-reconstructed.title: MRO reconstructed trajectory, primary science phase 47 (NAIF target -74 relative to Mars), little-endian DAF
mro-reconstructed.redistribution: redistributable; not committed, the E2E commits sampled states

maven-reconstructed.title: MAVEN reconstructed orbit (NAIF target -202 relative to Mars), 2021-01-01 to 2021-04-01, little-endian DAF
maven-reconstructed.redistribution: redistributable; not committed, the E2E commits sampled states

mars-exponential-atmosphere.title: Mars banded-exponential atmosphere table as NASA GMAT R2026a ships it: altitude of the band's bottom (km), density there (kg/m^3), scale height (km), 0 to 2980 km; the model form is Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications, section 8.6 (GMAT user guide, Exponential atmosphere)
mars-exponential-atmosphere.citation: NASA General Mission Analysis Tool R2026a, application/data/atmosphere/mars/MarsExponentialAtmosphereData.txt; the user guide does not state how the numbers were derived
mars-exponential-atmosphere.redistribution: redistributable with the license notice (NOTICE.md); the repository commits the 150 rows as lib/mars_atmosphere_data.h
